title: LTFRB pursues private vehicles giving transport services to online sellers

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Land Transportation Franchising and Regulatory Board (LTFRB) on Thursday said it launched a crackdown against private vehicles operating as transport or logistic services without proper permit or registration. According to LTFRB, it conducted a probe upon receiving reports from legitimate operators that several private vehicles are being used for truck-for-hire for online selling.
